This reaction forms the central C=C bond while retaining the methoxy‑substituted phenyl rings. Both starting materials are inexpensive and readily purchasable, keeping the total cost well below $150. The retrosynthesis tree therefore has the target molecule as the root, a single reaction node (McMurry coupling), and two identical leaf nodes representing 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde.</thought>
